fullDescription:
Introducing the Procreate Manga Megapack—an impressive collection of over 200 Procreate brushes and a manga canvas template that’s destined to simplify your manga or comic creation journey. This mega pack comes bundled with a variety of brushes including g-pen, kabura, maru, alongside screentones, speech bubbles, hatching, and cross-hatching halftone brushes.

It’s designed to seamlessly integrate with Procreate 5.2 software and be used on an iPad with an Apple Pencil to offer the utmost convenience and functionality.

Plunge into this vast collection and unveil the tools that will boost your creativity:

1. Manga Brushes, for when you wish to draw traditional manga art.
2. Real Screentone Brushes, for adding texture and depth to your creations.
3. Real Screentone Stamp Brushes, for that perfect dot pattern that’s synonymous with manga.
4. Cross Hatching Brushes, to help you add detailed shadows and highlights.
5. Manga Effect Brushes, to render those exciting special effects onto your drawings.
6. Speech Bubble Brushes, for infusing a dialogue into your story.
7. Halftone Manga Brushes, to simulate a vintage, printed comic feel.

This pack also includes a Manga Canvas Template and a Manga Storyboard Template to jumpstart your comic creation. With the Procreate Manga Megapack, crafting your very own manga masterpiece has never been easier.
